longTerm.title: Long-term commitment
longTerm.text: The map takes months to build. We are looking for people who will stay with us for the long run and work on their part regularly.

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.text: We are looking for people who can do their work precisely. Streets, splines and objects have to match the real Lublin, so details matter.

experience.title: Experience
experience.text: We are looking for people with experience and a portfolio, but we also welcome people with no experience (you will get learning materials).

contact.title: Contact

info.title: Info
info.about: Lublin is the largest city in eastern Poland and the capital of Lublin Voivodeship. Located on the Bystrzyca river, it is famous for its picturesque Old Town, the Lublin Castle with the Chapel of the Holy Trinity, and the Kraków Gate. It is an important academic center with several universities and tens of thousands of students. Lublin has one of the largest trolleybus networks in Poland, and public transport is operated by ZTM Lublin.
